**Three versions now** 🎮
Club runs on **1.21.1**, **1.21.8** and **1.21.11**. One jar per version — grab the one that matches your game, it says so right in the name.

**Particles are yours to choose** ✨
Every particle the game has, sorted into groups you can actually reason about. Flip them one by one, or turn a whole group off with its own switch. Everything is on by default — Club does not quietly take particles out of your game, and nothing is protected either.

**Item Scroll respects server rules** 🤝
On servers that forbid item scrolling, the feature simply is not there — no card, no hotkey, nothing to toggle. Leave, and it comes back on its own. One jar, and no switch to flip.

• 🎮 1.21.1 · 1.21.8 · 1.21.11
• ✨ Particles — 7 groups, every type the game has
• 🤝 Item Scroll off where it is banned
• ⚡ The Performance tab is gone — the work it did just happens now
